title: The Code of Silence
logline: A syndicate cleaner hires a pilot to deliver a 'care package' to an imprisoned informant, but the package is secretly a bomb.

roles.description: Terrified, bruised, realizing they have been completely abandoned.
Professional, polite, sees murder as simply balancing the books.
A pristine, heavily armed corporate interceptor.
A ruthless crime family built on absolute loyalty.

public_situation: A high-ranking member of the {role:local_syndicate} has been captured and is awaiting trial in a secure {role:holding_cell}.
private_truth: The syndicate knows the informant will crack, and has hired a cleaner to permanently silence them before the trial.

beats.public_change: The holding cell enters lockdown ahead of the informant's transfer.

missions.reason: The cleaner hires the pilot to deliver a locked 'care package' to the informant via automated drone slot.
missions.private_fact: The package contains a localized explosive designed to breach the cell's hull.

beats.public_change: The informant manages to smuggle out a scrambled comms burst before the package arrives.

missions.reason: The informant begs the pilot to remotely scan the package they just delivered.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the explosive payload, horrifying the pilot.

beats.public_change: The cleaner arrives in-system to ensure the job is done.

missions.reason: The informant pays the pilot to take on the cleaner's ship before it can finish the job.
missions.private_fact: Mid-fight, the cleaner hails the pilot, offering to split the fee if the pilot simply backs off and lets the package do its work.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the cleaner's ship.
resolutions.summary: The cleaner is dead. The informant escapes and pays the pilot handsomely before vanishing into the outer rim.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up a syndicate hitman to save a rat in holding.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the cleaner's offer or lets them win.
resolutions.summary: The package detonates, blowing the informant out into the void. The cleaner pays the pilot for their 'discretion'.
Nobody intervenes. The package does its work, the informant's testimony dies with them, and the cleaner quietly closes the contract.

loose_threads.detail: The bomb was constructed using refined corporate mining explosives, identical to those used by the local authorities.
The cleaner's communication logs show they received the hit order from the planetary governor's private estate.

radio_hooks: High-profile syndicate arrest promises to blow the lid off local corruption.

voice_direction.loyal_cleaner: Smooth, professional, uses euphemisms for death.
